{{Quote|These people, these Chirq Council or whatever they call themselves, are experimenting with some new heavy weapon prototypes. You seen what the ones we already have can do, right? Spew lava all over the place. Or acid. Things like that. Not exactly environmentally friendly. '''Jaalib Rigel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] environmentalist who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:DtCCEHW" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shhhh! There's usually a guard directly above us. Keep your voice low. Okay, if you're here to help me, than I'm grateful. Otherwise, be on your way and let me figure out my next move.|Jaalib Rigel, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DtCCEHW" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jaalib Rigel discovered that the criminals of the [[Chirq Council]] were developing heavy weapon prototypes in the [[Second Elite Council Bunker]], near the city of [[Doaba Guerfel/Legends|Doaba Guerfel]]. The man was concerned because those weapons would be very dangerous for the Corellian environment.<ref name="SWG:DtCCEHW" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vitala Baize]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] started an operation against the Chirq Council to destroy the organization and thus assaulted the [[First Elite Council Bunker|First]] and Second Elite Council Bunkers.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|The Chirq Council: The Elite Council|Corellia}}</ref> Jaalib Rigel encountered the CorSec agents near the Second Elite Council Bunker before their assault and requested them to deal with the weapons. An independent spacer who regularly worked for the CorSec agreed and then destroyed all the prototypes of each of the three experimental heavy weapon types.<ref name="SWG:DtCCEHW" /> Eventually, the Chirq Council splintered after the Chirq Council [[Elite Council|elite councilors]] were killed by the CorSec during the attacks of the Elite Council Bunkers.<ref name="SWG:TCCTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaalib Rigel was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DtCCEHW" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jaalib Rigel was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
